subject: Request for temporary sandbox credits while PO is in procurement
messages:
From: Jacob Li <j.li@novamed.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samira Ahmed <samira@novamed.ai>
Date: 2026-12-16T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Trial environment access while PO processes

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the engineers were impressed with the low-latency inference on our test prompts. We're lining up a purchase order but procurement flagged a few contract clauses and said the PO won't clear until next week at the earliest.

Our evaluation window will expire before that happens. Would Redwood be able to provision a short-term sandbox credit or promo so we can keep running tests (esp. fn-calling and longer sequence tests) while procurement finishes? Even a small credit bucket ~ $2k-$3k or two weeks of access would let us validate the final integration and move to signature faster.

I can share the PO PDF and the procurement contact if that helps. Appreciate any flexibility here — want to avoid losing momentum.

Best,
Jacob
Lead ML Engineer
NovaMed AI

Attachment: PO_template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jacob Li <j.li@novamed.ai>
Cc: Samira Ahmed <samira@novamed.ai>
Date: 2026-12-16T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial environment access while PO processes

Hi Jacob — great to hear the demo landed well.

We can absolutely help keep your evaluation moving. I can provision a temporary sandbox credit of $2,500 valid for 14 days while procurement completes. A couple quick notes:
- This is a one-time, discretionary grant tied to DEAL-7092.
- Credits will be applied to your account and time-limited; if you need more time we can revisit after we see the PO status.
- We ask for a PO or confirmation of intent (email copy is fine) so we have an internal audit trail.

If that works, reply with a confirmation of the account name to credit and I'll loop in finance for final sign-off and apply it.

Thanks — cc'ing our sales ops and finance owner for a quick review.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

--
Tessa Morgan
Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-12-17T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: [Approval request] Temporary $2.5k sandbox credit for NovaMed (DEAL-7092)

Hi Ben / Marissa — Jacob Li at NovaMed (DEAL-7092) has a PO stuck in procurement; they asked for a 2-week credit to keep validation running. I propose a one-time $2,500 sandbox credit attached to their account, expiring 14 days after activation.

Quick context:
- Account: NovaMed AI (contact: Jacob Li / Samira Ahmed)
- Reason: Procurement review delay; evaluation momentum at risk
- Ask: apply $2,500 credit, 14-day TTL, internal note: "temp-credit-procurement-delay-DEAL-7092"
- Attachments: SOW_v1.pdf (customer-signed scope) and the PO template they sent

Can you confirm for finance ops and record-keeping? If approved I'll notify the customer and apply the credit. If you'd like a signed MSA first, let me know — procurement said the PO references our standard MSA but they wanted clause clarifications which are taking a bit longer.

Thanks,
Tessa

Attachment: SOW_v1.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>

Jacob — quick update: we've approved the temporary sandbox credit. I've applied a $2,500 credit to NovaMed AI's sandbox project (DEAL-7092); it will expire 14 days from activation. You should see the credit reflected in the account billing page within an hour.

Notes: please ensure usage stays within the eval scope (inference + embeddings). If you anticipate going beyond the credit window let us know; we'll fast-track the PO review with procurement contacts.

Welcome aboard — excited to see what you build.

Best,
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
